location.basis: Centre of the open main mound east of a walled modern compound, read on the imagery at about 26.1735 N, 68.3230 E, with a second open mound to its south-west at about 26.1725 N, 68.3221 E; found from the published position 26.17361 N, 68.32306 E (Wikipedia, 26 deg 10 min 25 s N, 68 deg 19 min 23 s E).

main_system_reason: No system: we found no measurable Harappan line.
notes: The Esri imagery is a Vantor Vivid mosaic from a WorldView-3 scene of 21 May 2025 with real detail to zoom 18 (0.54 m per pixel). The mounds are low, eroded and partly wooded, between a walled modern compound to the west, a canal road to the south-east and irrigated fields. A patch of rubble-like texture on the main mound may mark recent excavation, but at full resolution and at 4.5x magnification it shows no wall or street line. The straight lines in the scene are the compound walls, the canal road and field boundaries, all modern. Chanhu-daro is not measurable from this imagery.
